summary: Project to maintain an up-to-date drug database/list, including full-list updates and post-update verification to ensure additions/updates apply correctly.
architectural_notes: Include a verification step after drug-list updates to confirm records were added/updated correctly and lists load fully.
known_issues: Automated build/deployment attempts failed with AI processing errors during full drug-list update request.

existing_features.title: Add a verification workflow that runs after a drug-list refresh/update to confirm that adds and updates were applied correctly, and expose the verification result to the UI.

Update the Drug Database UI to reliably render the entire corresponding dataset in the All Drugs / Approved / Banned tabs, with client-side search/category filters applied to the full list (not a partially loaded subset). If the list is large, implement a UI strategy (pagination or virtualization) that still allows viewing the full list while preserving existing search, CSV export, and the drug details modal.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update the entire drug list to be up-to-date, then run verification to ensure all items add/update correctly and lists load fully.

Update the application’s curated drug dataset so the complete drug list is up to date and includes missing entries as needed, ensuring every drug record includes at minimum: name, status (approved/banned), date, category (when known), description, source, and safetyInfo.

Ensure backend drug query methods return complete datasets (no truncation): `getAllDrugs` returns all approved + banned drugs, and filtered endpoints (approved/banned) return the full correctly filtered lists, independent of any user profile state.

projectName: Update full drug list dataset and add verification that additions/updates apply correctly
